zh: 智能計算器主入口改為《艾爾登法環》留言式的固定句式組裝器：先選收益、儲蓄生活目標、資產與退休、被動收入、產品比較類別，再選問題，逐個點擊詞塊調整條件。供款頻率、類型及其他選擇項使用固定下拉列表，金額、年期、利率使用數字輸入；不再公開自由文字意圖輸入框。
不重寫既有計算公式。固定條件直接映射到原本計算情境及問卷；特殊保單利益表使用原有專用後續編輯器。原有口語範例保留為內部回歸測試，不再依賴使用者猜中關鍵字。
新增選用 DeepSeek API 解讀渠道，支援現行 deepseek-flash、deepseek-v4-pro 模型。用戶自行輸入 API Key，僅保存在本次執行的記憶體；模型設定可保留但金鑰不能持久化。默認不聯網、不送資料，只有在結果頁明確點擊解讀時傳送已選條件和本地結果摘要。AI 不得取代或改寫本地數字。
攢錢目標、儲蓄目標與定投同步支援日／週／雙週／月／季／半年／年頻率，期限與供款頻率可獨立選；可指定不供款期數並據此重新計算實際本金、複利與達標期數。同步改進相關生活規劃共用計算頻率。
增補 2018 至 2026 縮寫年份反推年化、每年「買」7000、固定句式與 AI 金鑰安全回歸；修正大字短屏時附加條件區與滾動位置的儲存衝突。保留簡體、繁體及英文。
en: Replaced the Smart Calculator's freeform idea entry with an Elden Ring-inspired structured phrase composer: select a category and scenario, then tap dropdown slots for non-numeric conditions and enter amounts, dates/durations and rates numerically. Monetary calculations still run in the original local engine.
Existing specialist policy/table editors remain available after scenario selection, while legacy natural-language sentences remain regression fixtures rather than required user input.

Added an optional DeepSeek explanation channel with current deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro models. Users bring their own API key, retained in session memory only. No network request occurs for calculations; selected inputs and results are sent only after an explicit Explain action. AI output cannot change the locally computed results.

Extended savings goals, periodic deposit goals and DCA with daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, semiannual and annual schedules, separate duration units and skipped contribution periods; updated shared planning frequencies.

Added regression coverage for short calendar-year phrases, colloquial annual purchases, dropdown/numeric-only user interactions and DeepSeek privacy; fixed an expansion/scroll PageStorage conflict on small, large-text screens.
